```sql
select
  null as key,
  count(*) as value
from payment_attempts a
join orders o on o.order_id = a.order_id
join showrooms s on s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
where not a.is_test
  and not o.is_test
  and s.country_code = 'GB'
  and a.method = 'card'
  and a.status = 'failed'
  and a.business_date between date '2026-08-31' and date '2026-09-06'
order by value
```
